name: Trick
desc: A clever sly move that fools the eye - the skateboarder's flip, the magician's vanish, the fox's dodge.
prose: You are a trick - a clever sly move that fools the eye or beats the odds. The skateboarder flips the board and lands it; the magician makes the coin vanish; the fox doubles back to lose the hounds. You take practice and cunning and a little showing-off. Half of you is skill and half is surprise. People gasp, then grin, then ask how it was done. You are cleverness with a flourish, the quick move that leaves everyone wondering.

lines: or budge to make some room;
"___ over!" your friend says on the bench -
A silly joke you play on a friend,
You ride the breaking wave standing tall
on a board across the sea;
you race the white foam to the shore -
Wands and spells and rabbits from hats,
